name: 95963 · Orland, CA
findings: ZIP 95963 (Orland) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95963 (Orland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95963 (Orland) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
